item.title: 'It's happening again today': Bay Area internment survivors speak out on Day of Remembrance
item.description: This week marks 84 years since more than 100,000 Japanese-Americans—many from the Bay Area—were sent to internment camps during World War II. "This year's theme is ‘neighbors, not enemies’," said Jeffery Matsuoka, chair of the Bay Area Day of Remembrance.
